title: Tiny, cute bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tub body -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q18 78 44 80 L68 80 Q88 78 88 52 Z' fill='#9fd8f2' stroke='#d9f4ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- tub rim -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='52' rx='35' ry='7' fill='#e8f8ff' stroke='#a8e0f7' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='52' rx='29' ry='4.5' fill='#3fc4f0'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='47' r='4' fill='#dff7ff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='43' r='3' fill='#f2fcff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#dff7ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#f2fcff'/>
  <!-- tap -->
  <rect x='71' y='30' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ffd76e' stroke='#fff0bd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='58' y='28' width='20' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ffcf4d' stroke='#fff0bd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M60 35 Q58 42 60 45' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8f5' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='24' y='80' width='9' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <rect x='67' y='80' width='9' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- rubber duck -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='49' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffd234'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffd234'/>
  <path d='M39 44 L44 45.5 L39 46.5 Z' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='43' r='0.9' fill='#5a3a00'/>
</svg>
